overview.heading: To the Foot of Mount Everest
overview.subheading: Through the spiritual heartland of the Sherpa people
overview.content:
The Everest Base Camp trek stands as one of the world's quintessential mountain journeys. Beginning with an exhilarating scenic flight into Lukla, you step directly into high Himalayan terrain where suspension bridges draped with prayer flags span turquoise glacial rivers.

Over two carefully paced weeks, you will acclimatise in the bustling mountain trading capital of Namche Bazaar, visit the revered Tengboche Monastery with panoramic vistas of Ama Dablam, and traverse lunar moraine landscapes into Gorak Shep.

Standing at Everest Base Camp (5,364m) before the formidable Khumbu Icefall, followed by a dawn summit of Kala Patthar (5,550m), delivers an unmatched view of Mount Everest, Lhotse, Nuptse, and Pumori.
overview.highlight: A demanding Himalayan journey defined by altitude, changing landscapes, rich Sherpa heritage, and unforgettable encounters beneath the world's highest summits.
highlights: Stand at Everest Base Camp (5,364m) directly beside the Khumbu Icefall
Dawn climb of Kala Patthar (5,550m) for panoramic sunrise vistas of Mount Everest
Two nights in vibrant Namche Bazaar with guided acclimatisation hikes
Visit the spiritual heart of the Khumbu at Tengboche Buddhist Monastery
Full private logistics support from seasoned Sherpa guides and dedicated porter crew

itinerary_section.heading: 15 Days Through the Khumbu Valley
itinerary_section.subtext: Open each day to inspect the planned trail route, elevation profile, meals, accommodation, and walking times.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Kathmandu & Hotel Transfer
itinerary.description: Welcome to Nepal! Upon clearing customs at Tribhuvan International Airport, an expedition representative will greet you and escort you by private vehicle to your boutique heritage hotel. Enjoy a leisurely afternoon followed by a comprehensive pre-trek briefing and welcome dinner.
itinerary.pills: Meals: Welcome Dinner · Boutique Heritage Hotel

itinerary.title: Scenic Mountain Flight to Lukla & Hike to Phakding
itinerary.description: Early morning scenic flight to Tenzing-Hillary Airport in Lukla. Meet your Sherpa trekking crew, adjust daypacks, and begin the gentle downward hike along the Dudh Koshi riverbank through pine and rhododendron woods to the village of Phakding.
itinerary.pills: Meals: B, L, D · Teahouse Lodge · Approx. 3–4 hrs

itinerary.title: Ascend to the Sherpa Capital of Namche Bazaar
itinerary.description: Cross the high Hillary Suspension Bridge adorned with wind-whipped prayer flags and begin the sustained zig-zag ascent through Sagarmatha National Park into Namche Bazaar, where your first glimpse of Mount Everest appears through the trees.
itinerary.pills: Meals: B, L, D · Mountain Lodge · Approx. 5–6 hrs

itinerary.title: Acclimatisation Day & Viewpoint Hike
itinerary.description: Rest and acclimatise. Undertake a panoramic morning hike up to the Everest View Hotel (3,880m) for sweeping vistas of Ama Dablam, Thamserku, and Everest. Explore the local Sherpa culture museum and vibrant weekend market.
itinerary.pills: Meals: B, L, D · Mountain Lodge · Approx. 3–4 hrs

itinerary.title: Trail to Tengboche Monastery with Ama Dablam Views
itinerary.description: Follow a contouring path above the Imja Khola river before descending to Phunki Tenga for lunch. Climb steadily through birch and fir forests to reach the ridge-top spiritual sanctuary of Tengboche Monastery, set against an awe-inspiring backdrop of Ama Dablam.
itinerary.pills: Meals: B, L, D · Mountain Lodge · Approx. 5 hrs

faqs.question: What is the best season to undertake the Everest Base Camp trek?
faqs.answer: The premier seasons are spring (March through May) for stable skies, longer days, and blooming rhododendron valleys, and autumn (late September through November) for crisp visibility and pristine mountain views.

faqs.question: How fit do I need to be, and how is altitude managed?
faqs.answer: A solid foundation of cardiovascular endurance is essential. Our itineraries include built-in acclimatisation rest days in Namche Bazaar, gradual altitude gain, and twice-daily pulse oximeter monitoring by your lead Sherpa guide.

faqs.question: What standard of accommodation and meals can I expect?
faqs.answer: In Kathmandu, you will stay in 4/5-star boutique heritage hotels. On the trail, you will stay in comfortable teahouses with private twin rooms and hearty multi-course meals prepared fresh daily.
